beliefs.label: Show Love
beliefs.statement: I show love by making the next step easier

receipts.quote: Nora's exhibit opening ran late, so I packed her dinner in a jar and brought it to the museum. I labeled the lid with reheating instructions.
My sister mentioned a clinic appointment, so I drove her and waited with coffee. I had already checked the parking rules.

beliefs.label: Want Hard
beliefs.statement: I want hard things named before they become a private story

receipts.quote: When Nora said the kitchen felt crowded, I asked whether she meant the dishes or us. She said she had missed eating together.
My brother stopped returning calls, and I told him I was worried instead of sending memes. He called that evening.

beliefs.label: Steady Without
beliefs.statement: I can be steady without having every answer

receipts.quote: A student asked whether the bridge design would hold, and I said we could test the weak point together. The model bent but did not break.
The landlord could not say when the elevator would be fixed. I carried groceries upstairs and made another plan for Monday.

beliefs.label: Students Deserve
beliefs.statement: Students deserve to see how a question is worked, not just solved

receipts.quote: In physics lab, I let students show the wrong measurements on the board and asked where the method changed. They found the loose clamp.
A student gave the right answer without units, so I asked her to show the path for the class. She caught her own conversion.

beliefs.label: Listen Best
beliefs.statement: I listen best when someone says what they need from me

receipts.quote: Nora said she was upset about my late lesson plans, and I asked if she wanted an apology, a schedule, or company. She picked the schedule.
My principal asked whether I could help with a parent night. I asked what part needed doing before agreeing.

beliefs.label: Reach For
beliefs.statement: I reach for humor when a moment feels exposed

receipts.quote: When Nora asked why I had not called, I joked that the phone had betrayed me. Her face told me the joke had covered the point.
A coworker criticized my lab setup, and I made a pun about gravity before admitting I was embarrassed. We fixed the table.

beliefs.label: Home Feels
beliefs.statement: Home feels fair when decisions are made together before they are urgent

receipts.quote: Before signing a new lease, Nora and I sat at the table with both pay stubs and listed what each change would mean. We chose the smaller place together.
We decided on a dishwasher only after comparing repair costs and who would be home for delivery. Neither of us found out afterward.

beliefs.label: Good Experiment
beliefs.statement: A good experiment includes the result that surprised you

receipts.quote: Our pendulum experiment gave a strange result, so I wrote it beside the expected one and had the class test it again. The second run taught more.
A paper bridge collapsed under half the predicted weight. We photographed the buckle before rebuilding it.

shared_items.label: How I mean things
shared_items.statement: I often begin with a joke, then say the concrete point.

shared_items.label: What feels like care
shared_items.statement: Someone making a plan with me feels more caring than a grand gesture.

shared_items.label: How to bring something up with me
shared_items.statement: Tell me what you need, and do not make me solve the hidden version.
